begin PaperLanScript

short counter

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
  return
endif

if ( counter < 60 )
  set counter to counter + 1
  return
endif

set counter to 0

if ( GetLOS Player == 0 )
  if ( GetHealth > 0 )
  if ( GameHour > 20 )
    disable
  elseif ( GameHour < 8 )
    disable
  elseif ( GetCurrentWeather > 3 )
   disable
  else
    enable
  endif
  endif
endif

end
Interested in some special glass lanterns, %PCName?
Are you here for Ja'dahna's lanterns?
Hello, %PCRace. Do you need lanterns for your travels?
I'm a glass worker here in Vivec. Dunmer glass lanterns are special in how they're made and I am one of the few who know how to make them.

Ja'dahna came to Vvardenfell to start a new life. Arrille was kind to Ja'dahna and let her stay and sell her lanterns in his tradehouse before Ja'dahna could afford her own home. Ja'hdahna now sells lanterns from her own home.
I'm just a woman trying to get by while preserving part of Dunmer culture.
%Name hears you. %Name is in the guild.
Many of the glass lanterns seen around Vvardenfell are made here.
Ja'dahna sells lanterns from foriegn lands. Does this %PCName wish to buy Ja'dahna's lanterns?
I make and sell traditional Dunmer paper lanterns. A lot of the paper lanterns you see here are ones I have made. Interested?
